cases.what: two sequential PUTs produce one row and one notification
eight concurrent PUTs produce one row and one notification
a like on a restricted post notifies exactly once
the recipient is the author and the actor is the liker
withdrawing the like removes the notification
a withdrawn and repeated like notifies again
a refused like writes no notification
the notification table carries only identity and time, with no age or gender column

limitations: The recipient's inbox read (marking an entry read, ordering) is WP-05's activity feed and is not part of this verification.
